items.title: Free ParentCraft class on Monday
items.summary: Pregnancy health and parent-infant mental health, 5:30–7 pm at Anthony S. Eden Hospital, Hibiscus Conference Room, off Pines Drive.
items.eligibility: Expectant parents.
items.source_title: HSA ParentCraft class
items.qualification: HSA describes the course as free with no registration. Confirm the session before travelling. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.title: Flu vaccination at the hospital
items.summary: Anthony S. Eden Hospital Atrium sessions run through 9 October, 10 am–noon. First come, first served while supplies last; no appointment required.
items.eligibility: HSA encourages people aged six months and older; individual suitability is for a healthcare professional.
items.source_title: HSA 2026/27 flu vaccination notice
items.qualification: Programme window, not continuous opening. Confirm the day’s session with HSA; the captured notice does not establish a price. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.title: District flu vaccination sessions start 12 October
items.summary: HSA lists weekday sessions at District Health Centres and General Practice Clinic, 2:30–4 pm, beginning 12 October.
items.source_title: HSA 2026/27 flu vaccination notice
items.qualification: No programme end date is published here. Contact the relevant centre for the day’s availability, suitability and any charge. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.title: Pertussis vaccination clinic on 10 October
items.summary: HSA lists a 9 am–1 pm clinic at 150 Smith Road.
items.source_title: HSA pertussis vaccine clinic
items.qualification: The event does not state a price. Check vaccine suitability and attendance requirements with Public Health. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.source_title: HSA historical kidney screening
items.qualification: Historical event retained to prevent an old search result being mistaken for a current invitation. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.title: Scholarship cycle changes: check the programme
items.summary: The 30 April update announces a 1 November 2026 annual-cycle opening and no October applications. The Ministry FAQ still lists earlier windows.
items.eligibility: Criteria vary by programme; the update describes eligible Caymanians aged 17 or older.
items.source_title: MoET scholarship cycle update
items.qualification: Conflicting official guidance: confirm the specific programme in the current portal or with the Secretariat. No guaranteed opening time, eligibility or award.
documents: Required medical documentation for overseas applicants

items.title: Local TVET grant guidance
items.summary: The Ministry FAQ says applications may be submitted year-round and decisions are issued quarterly.
items.eligibility: Caymanians pursuing eligible local technical or vocational training; the Ministry assesses applications.
items.source_title: Scholarship Secretariat FAQ
items.qualification: Evergreen guidance, not a dated opening or award guarantee. Confirm current programme rules in the portal.

items.title: Check financial assistance requirements
items.summary: Government guidance describes nationality or family-link, residence and household financial tests. Review the requirements before applying.
items.source_title: Government financial assistance eligibility
items.qualification: Reference updated 10 October 2024; not a finding that you qualify. Household thresholds and the final assessment must be checked with DFA.

items.title: Check Water Authority alerts before travelling
items.summary: Use the official interruption notices for locations, work windows and restoration updates.
items.source_title: Water Authority official alerts
items.qualification: Reference only. The September notices shown are not current October outages. No alert does not prove that every address has water. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.summary: Read the official archive and confirm the date and affected road before changing your route.
items.source_title: RCIPS October 2026 archive
items.qualification: The October archive returned no listed notices in the reviewed capture. This is not proof that there are no road disruptions. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.source_title: HSA events and classes

items.source_title: CICBD Small Business Expo

items.title: Free ParentCraft class on 26 October
items.summary: Gross motor skills and paediatric feeding and weaning, 5:30–7 pm at Anthony S. Eden Hospital, Hibiscus Conference Room.
items.eligibility: Expectant parents.
items.source_title: HSA ParentCraft class
items.qualification: HSA describes the course as free with no registration. Confirm the session before travelling. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

items.title: CSC 2027 registration deadline: 20 November
items.summary: The Civil Service College registration page lists 20 November 2026 for programmes starting in 2027, including leadership and workplace digital skills.
items.eligibility: Programme-specific eligibility is assessed by the College; this listing does not guarantee admission.
items.source_title: Civil Service College 2027 registration
items.qualification: Confirmed calendar date only; closing hour is not stated. Confirm admission, employment eligibility, course cost and the relevant programme before applying.

items.title: Electricity fuel-charge cap and fuel duty waiver now run to 31 December
items.summary: Government extended the 2026 Fuel Relief Programme by three months. The residential electricity fuel charge stays capped at CI$0.18 per kWh, and the 100% import-duty waiver on gasoline, diesel and propane continues.
items.eligibility: Residential electricity customers using between 101 and 3,500 kWh a month get relief on the first 2,000 kWh. The release says the cap covers nearly 95% of households on all three islands.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Government extends fuel relief programme through December 2026
items.qualification: The waiver removes the Government duty; it does not set or freeze pump prices. The release's example saving is about $70.44 a month on 1,200 kWh at September's fuel rate.

items.title: Duty-free allowance is CI$800 now and CI$1,000 from 23 November
items.summary: The standard allowance for returning residents rose from CI$500 to CI$800 on 1 September. A temporary CI$1,000 allowance applies for Christmas travel, 23 November 2026 to 7 January 2027, then CI$800 resumes on 8 January.
items.eligibility: Returning residents bringing in personal and household goods.
items.source_title: GOV.KY: Cabinet Approves Increased Duty Allowances for Returning Residents
items.qualification: For the summer window the release said the higher allowance applied at the discretion of Customs and Border Control. Check declaration rules with CBC before you travel.

items.title: Free shuttle now links East End and North Side
items.summary: The Eastern Link is a free four-month public transport pilot that started 1 October. It runs Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am to 7:30 pm, not on public holidays. If you transfer to an existing public bus, the normal bus fare applies.
items.eligibility: Open to passengers in the eastern districts.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): The Eastern Link Connecting East End and North Side to Launch 1 October
items.qualification: The release names three services and Frank Sound Junction as the connection to existing buses; stop lists were attachments not shown on the page. No end date is given beyond four months. The four-month duration is stated, but an exact end date is not supplied.

items.title: Government schools are closed to students from Thursday 15 to Friday 23 October
items.summary: Two teacher training days on 15 and 16 October run straight into the half-term break of 19 to 23 October. That is seven school days in a row with no classes.
items.eligibility: Government primary and secondary schools. Private schools set their own dates.
items.source_title: GOV.KY: Cayman Islands Government Schools 2026-2027 School Calendar (approved April 2026)
items.qualification: From the approved calendar PDF. The calendar lists no closure on Monday 26 October. Confirm with your child's school.

items.title: Public holidays left this year: 9 November, 25 December and 28 December
items.summary: Remembrance Day is Monday 9 November. Christmas Day is Friday 25 December and Boxing Day is observed on Monday 28 December. Government offices close on public holidays.
items.eligibility: Everyone.
items.source_title: GOV.KY: Public Holidays
items.qualification: The official 2026 list has no October public holiday. Check the Government list before treating another listing as an official holiday.

items.title: Cayman Airways' last nonstop New York flight is 19 October
items.summary: The airline is ending its Grand Cayman to New York JFK nonstop service. The final flight operates on 19 October 2026.
items.eligibility: Anyone booked on, or planning, nonstop travel to New York.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Cayman Airways to conclude its New York service
items.qualification: If you hold a booking after 19 October, check it with Cayman Airways. The release does not describe rebooking or refunds.

items.title: Expect more mosquitoes, most of all in the eastern districts
items.summary: The Mosquito Research and Control Unit warned on 30 September of more mosquito activity across all three islands after high tides and rain. It asks residents to empty anything in the yard that holds water.
items.eligibility: Everyone.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): MRCU Advises of Expected Increase in Mosquito Activity
items.qualification: The advisory spoke of 'the coming days' from 30 September and gives no end date.

items.title: Police: never share your six-digit WhatsApp code
items.summary: RCIPS says scammers are taking over local WhatsApp accounts by asking for the six-digit verification code, then messaging the owner's contacts for money. Turn on two-step verification, and call the person before sending money.
items.eligibility: Everyone who uses WhatsApp.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Police Warn of Ongoing WhatsApp Impersonation Scams
items.qualification: The advice to call the person first is ordinary caution, not a quote from the release.

items.title: Statistics Office interviewers are visiting about 2,000 homes: ask for the ESO ID card
items.summary: The Fall Labour Force and Quality of Life surveys began on Sunday 27 September. Trained interviewers carry Economics and Statistics Office ID cards. To check, call the ESO on 516-3329 or 949-0940.
items.eligibility: About 2,000 randomly selected households.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Fall 2026 Labour Force Survey and Quality of Life Survey Starts Sunday
items.qualification: The notice gives no end date for fieldwork.

items.title: Driving licence fees changed on 1 September: discounts for longer licences, reduced fee at 65
items.summary: Caymanians buying three-, five- and ten-year licences get 10%, 15% and 20% off. Customers aged 65 or older qualify for the reduced fee, including non-Caymanian seniors. Non-Caymanian full licence fees are about three times the Caymanian rate, down from the eight times first approved.
items.eligibility: DVDL uses Government records to decide which fee applies. If it cannot verify you electronically, the transaction goes to manual verification: bring valid ID and supporting documents.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Revised DVDL Fee Structure Effective 1 September 2026
items.qualification: If you think the wrong fee was applied, go to a DVDL office with your receipt and ID. The release gives ratios and discounts, not a full price list.

items.title: Have your say on protecting George Town's Ironwood Forest by 20 November
items.summary: The National Conservation Council is asking for public comments on protecting a 10.3-acre Crown parcel of dry forest in central George Town.
items.eligibility: Open to the public. The page says no personal information will be published.
items.source_title: Cayman Islands Government public consultations: Ironwood Forest
items.qualification: The page gives a closing date and no closing hour.

items.title: Cayman Brac: comment on the proposed Bluff Lighthouse National Park by 20 November
items.summary: The National Conservation Council is asking for public comments on protecting Crown parcels along the north-eastern Bluff, including all of Long Beach, while keeping the area open for managed public access.
items.eligibility: Open to the public.
items.source_title: Cayman Islands Government public consultations: Cayman Brac Lighthouse National Park
items.qualification: The page gives a closing date and no closing hour.

items.title: Free all-day AI and technology summit on Tuesday 6 October, lunch included
items.summary: Tech Futures Week's Innovation Summit is at the Harquail Theatre. The listing describes it as a free, full-day summit with lunch included, on what AI means for Cayman.
items.eligibility: The listing invites Cayman's technology, business, investment and entrepreneurial communities.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government) community events: Tech Futures Week Innovation Summit
items.qualification: The listing gives no start time and does not say whether you must register. Check before travelling.

items.title: Pirates Week dates: Brac 30 to 31 October, Grand Cayman 6 to 14 November, Little Cayman 20 to 21 November
items.summary: The Minister reconfirmed the 2026 festival dates for all three islands. Road closures for the Grand Cayman events had not been published when this was checked.
items.eligibility: Everyone.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Pirates Week 2026 Theme Revealed
items.qualification: Dates only. Event times, costs and road closures are not stated in this festival release; check current official event and police notices.

items.title: Importing a car? Model year eight years or older is prohibited
items.summary: Customs and Border Control reminded the public on 14 September that vehicles whose model year is eight years or older cannot be imported, subject to listed exemptions. It asks buyers to check before purchasing as the end of the year approaches.
items.eligibility: Anyone buying a vehicle overseas to bring into Cayman.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): CBC Reminds Public of Vehicle Import Restrictions
items.qualification: Exemptions are in Section 4A(2) of the Prohibited Goods Order; the release does not list them. Ask CBC before you buy.

items.title: New rules for bringing dogs and cats into Cayman took effect 1 October
items.summary: The Department of Agriculture revised the conditions for importing dogs and cats. If you travel with a pet or plan to bring one in, check the new requirements first. Contact the Department on 947-3090.
items.eligibility: Anyone bringing a dog or cat into the Cayman Islands.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Department of Agriculture advisory on importation conditions for dogs and cats
items.qualification: This entry does not summarise the individual requirements. Read the advisory or ask the Department.

items.title: Government schools: no personal phones during the school day
items.summary: The Ministry of Education published its Mobile Phone (Safe School) Policy on 28 September. In all government schools, students may not use personal mobile phones or other connected devices during the school day, with listed exceptions.
items.eligibility: Students at government schools.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): MoET Publishes Mobile Phone Policy
items.qualification: The exceptions are in the policy itself and are not listed here.

items.title: Proposed: work permit vacancies would no longer have to be advertised in a newspaper
items.summary: The Minister for Caymanian Employment and Immigration told Parliament on 2 October he intends to change work permit advertising rules. Under the proposal, employers would continue to advertise vacancies on the WORC Jobs Portal for at least 21 days before applying for a permit; the local-newspaper requirement would go.
items.eligibility: Job seekers and employers.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Minister Signals Proposed Changes to Work Permit Advertising Requirements
items.qualification: A stated proposal, not a rule in force. The release says approval by Caucus and Cabinet is still required; no commencement date is given.

items.title: Chamber's Mentoring Cayman needs mentors: apply by 30 October
items.summary: The Chamber of Commerce pairs Year 11 students with professionals for a six-month programme. It is accepting mentor applications for 2026/27 until 30 October.
items.eligibility: Professionals across the Cayman Islands.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): Mentoring Cayman Seeks Mentors to Help Shape the Future
items.qualification: A Chamber of Commerce programme, carried by Radio Cayman. The application form link is in the release.

items.title: East End: youth workshop at Gun Bay Civic Centre, Saturday 10 October, 2 to 6 pm
items.summary: The Youth Development Consortium invites young people to its Everyone's an Asset Build Workshop.
items.eligibility: Young people. The listing gives no age range.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government) community events: Everyone's an Asset Build Workshop
items.qualification: The listing does not state a cost or whether you must register.

items.title: Parade on West Bay Road, Saturday 10 October from 3:30 pm
items.summary: Cayman Pride starts at XQ's on West Bay Road and goes to the Kimpton Seafire Resort. Allow extra time on West Bay Road that afternoon.
items.eligibility: Drivers and bus passengers on West Bay Road.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government) community events: Cayman Pride
items.qualification: The community listing describes a parade route; it does not confirm a police road closure. Allowing extra travel time is planning guidance.

items.title: No-cost mammogram in October for CG BritCay Premier and Provident members
items.summary: The insurer says members of those two plans can get a mammogram at Doctors Hospital with nothing to pay out of pocket during October, without using their annual wellness allowance. Appointments are limited. The booking number is in the insurer's notice; say which plan you are on when you call.
items.eligibility: Members covered under a CG BritCay Premier or Provident health plan.
items.source_title: Radio Cayman (Government): CG BritCay reintroduces complimentary mammogram initiative
items.qualification: A company's offer to its own policyholders, carried by Radio Cayman. Listed because it is a benefit members may not know they have; it is not an advertisement or an endorsement.

items.title: Water Authority rates went up 3% from 1 July
items.summary: The first base-price change in seven years. For Grand Cayman homes, the first 12 cubic metres a month (about 3,200 US gallons) went from $4.34 to $4.47 per cubic metre.
items.eligibility: Water Authority customers.
items.source_title: Water Authority-Cayman: Water Authority Announces Base Price Adjustment
items.qualification: The figure quoted is for the first consumption band in Grand Cayman only. Other bands and the Sister Islands are in the notice.

items.title: Financial assistance decisions: ask for reconsideration within 21 working days
items.summary: A person unhappy with a Department of Financial Assistance decision must first seek reconsideration within 21 working days after notice. If still unhappy, or DFA declines to reconsider, an appeal can follow within 28 working days after that decision is communicated.
items.eligibility: Applicants and recipients dissatisfied with a Department of Financial Assistance decision.
items.action_label: Read the appeal steps and forms
items.source_title: GOV.KY: Minister and Financial Assistance Appeals Tribunal Discuss Fair, Accessible Appeals
items.qualification: The release explains appeal deadlines, not financial-assistance eligibility. It directs applicants to Tribunal forms and procedures; check the applicable dates promptly.

items.title: Water cut for non-payment? Clear the balance and a $25 reconnection charge
items.summary: The Water Authority says customers whose service was interrupted for non-payment must pay all outstanding service charges before restoration, plus a $25 reconnection charge.
items.eligibility: Water Authority customers whose service was interrupted due to non-payment.
items.source_title: Water Authority Cayman: Services Interruption
items.qualification: The page does not say when this charge last changed. It says customers who cannot pay in full before the due date should contact Customer Service.

items.title: George Town: water pipe works on Rockshire Drive until about early November
items.summary: Water Authority works on Rockshire Drive started on 23 September and are expected to last about six weeks, depending on weather. Expect trenching and heavy equipment, and brief water interruptions of under 30 minutes when homes are switched to a temporary line and again to the new one.
items.eligibility: Customers on or near Rockshire Drive in George Town.
items.action_label: Read the Rockshire Drive work notice
items.source_title: Water Authority: Planned Works - Rockshire Drive Pipeline Upgrade and Relaying Project
items.qualification: The six-week duration is approximate and depends on weather. Interruptions are described as brief connection events, not a continuous outage.

items.title: WORC offices in Grand Cayman and Cayman Brac close on 30 October
items.summary: WORC says its Grand Cayman and Cayman Brac offices will be closed Friday, 30 October, for a staff event. Regular office hours resume Monday, 2 November.
items.eligibility: Customers planning to visit a WORC office in Grand Cayman or Cayman Brac.
items.source_title: GOV.KY Noticeboard: WORC Office Closure Notice
items.qualification: The notice says regular hours resume on 2 November but does not state alternate service arrangements.

items.title: Immigration law transition: existing permits and earlier applications get protection
items.summary: Immigration amendments took effect on 1 May 2026. Applications and appeals already submitted remain under the law then in force; valid work permits remain effective until expiry, and new eligibility requirements and timelines do not apply to people who already hold valid permissions or status.
items.eligibility: People with valid immigration permissions or status, and people whose applications or appeals were submitted before 1 May 2026.
items.source_title: Ministry of Caymanian Employment and Immigration: Immigration Reform
items.qualification: This item covers transitional arrangements for existing permissions and pre-commencement applications and appeals; it does not describe the full set of new permit requirements.

items.title: No school for students on Friday 4 December; term ends 18 December at 1 pm
items.summary: 4 December is a system-wide teacher training day. Government schools close for Christmas on 18 December, when students leave at 1:00 pm. Term 2 starts on 4 January 2027.
items.eligibility: Government primary and secondary schools. Private schools set their own dates.
items.source_title: GOV.KY: Cayman Islands Government Schools 2026-2027 School Calendar (approved April 2026)
items.qualification: 4 December is the single-day closure in this calendar entry; 18 December is the separate term-end date. The approved PDF also gives a 4 January 2027 reopening. Confirm with your child's school.

fine_print.title: Scholarship dates disagree across official pages
fine_print.summary: The dated April update announces a November–September cycle from 1 November 2026. The Ministry FAQ still shows the earlier overseas and local windows.
fine_print.qualification: Revision comparison only. The public portal landing does not settle a programme-specific deadline; confirm directly before preparing an application.
changes: New dated update: annual cycle starts 1 November 2026; no October applications.
Undated FAQ still lists overseas 15 November–31 January and local 1 March–30 April.
Update requires final academic results; FAQ still describes conditional applications while results are pending.

fine_print.title: Gazette timetable and generic instructions differ
fine_print.summary: The 2026 table and the general submission paragraph on the same official page give different deadline rules.
fine_print.qualification: The dated 2026 table lists 16 October at noon for both sectors; the same page’s generic instructions use different weekday rules. Confirm with the Gazette Office before relying on this deadline.
changes: 2026 table: both government and private-sector submissions for Issue 22 on Friday 16 October at noon.
Generic paragraph: government notices on the preceding Wednesday; commercial notices on the preceding Friday.
This is a discrepancy within one page, not proof of when either section changed.

slides.headline: Free shuttle now links East End and North Side
slides.label: The Eastern Link is a free four-month public transport pilot that started 1 October. It runs Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am to 7:30 pm, not on public holidays. If you transfer to an existing public bus, the normal bus fare applies.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): The Eastern Link Connecting East End and North Side to Launch 1 October
slides.qualification: The release names three services and Frank Sound Junction as the connection to existing buses; stop lists were attachments not shown on the page. No end date is given beyond four months. The four-month duration is stated, but an exact end date is not supplied.

slides.headline: Electricity fuel-charge cap and fuel duty waiver now run to 31 December
slides.label: Government extended the 2026 Fuel Relief Programme by three months. The residential electricity fuel charge stays capped at CI$0.18 per kWh, and the 100% import-duty waiver on gasoline, diesel and propane continues.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): Government extends fuel relief programme through December 2026
slides.qualification: The waiver removes the Government duty; it does not set or freeze pump prices. The release's example saving is about $70.44 a month on 1,200 kWh at September's fuel rate.

slides.headline: Duty-free allowance is CI$800 now and CI$1,000 from 23 November
slides.label: The standard allowance for returning residents rose from CI$500 to CI$800 on 1 September. A temporary CI$1,000 allowance applies for Christmas travel, 23 November 2026 to 7 January 2027, then CI$800 resumes on 8 January.
slides.source_label: GOV.KY: Cabinet Approves Increased Duty Allowances for Returning Residents
slides.qualification: For the summer window the release said the higher allowance applied at the discretion of Customs and Border Control. Check declaration rules with CBC before you travel.

slides.headline: No-cost mammogram in October for CG BritCay Premier and Provident members
slides.label: The insurer says members of those two plans can get a mammogram at Doctors Hospital with nothing to pay out of pocket during October, without using their annual wellness allowance. Appointments are limited. The booking number is in the insurer's notice; say which plan you are on when you call.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): CG BritCay reintroduces complimentary mammogram initiative
slides.qualification: A company's offer to its own policyholders, carried by Radio Cayman. Listed because it is a benefit members may not know they have; it is not an advertisement or an endorsement.

slides.qualification: Evergreen guidance, not a dated opening or award guarantee. Confirm current programme rules in the portal.

slides.headline: Check financial assistance requirements
slides.label: Government guidance describes nationality or family-link, residence and household financial tests. Review the requirements before applying.
slides.qualification: Reference updated 10 October 2024; not a finding that you qualify. Household thresholds and the final assessment must be checked with DFA.

slides.headline: Small Business Expo on 21 October

slides.qualification: The date is confirmed; start/end times and admission price are not stated in the captured text. Exhibitor applications closed 13 September. Confirm attendance details.

slides.headline: Importing a car? Model year eight years or older is prohibited
slides.label: Customs and Border Control reminded the public on 14 September that vehicles whose model year is eight years or older cannot be imported, subject to listed exemptions. It asks buyers to check before purchasing as the end of the year approaches.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): CBC Reminds Public of Vehicle Import Restrictions
slides.qualification: Exemptions are in Section 4A(2) of the Prohibited Goods Order; the release does not list them. Ask CBC before you buy.

slides.headline: Scholarship dates disagree across official pages
slides.label: The dated April update announces a November–September cycle from 1 November 2026. The Ministry FAQ still shows the earlier overseas and local windows.
slides.qualification: Revision comparison only. The public portal landing does not settle a programme-specific deadline; confirm directly before preparing an application.

slides.headline: Gazette timetable and generic instructions differ

slides.qualification: The dated 2026 table lists 16 October at noon for both sectors; the same page’s generic instructions use different weekday rules. Confirm with the Gazette Office before relying on this deadline.
